R1.description: A role=owner acquisition of the caller's own current-epoch takeover guard (same token and worktree) is refused by a new branch of the claim guard's decision placed between the superseded-epoch branch and the same-worktree reclaim, with its own accurate message; every other branch keeps its condition and message; a live same-worktree owner (1d and 1f-commit) is refused before and after the rotation and the takeover completes

R2.description: The plan-approval journal guard gets the same rule (a role=owner acquisition of a guard whose step is takeover and whose token is the caller's is refused with its own message), with a deterministic before/after-rotation interleaving test

R3.description: The next step a refusal names for a leftover takeover guard (a crashed takeover) is the route that clears it, re-running the takeover with the guard-release authorization, not clear_malformed_guard or the destructive recovery, proven by a test for both guards

R4.description: Release 2.18.5: release constant and pinned assertions, manifest digests, sizes, measured suite counts and per-record rationales, release history closing #82 only (#55 stays open for W19), downgrade posture and the manager block (min_manager_version 1.13.0)
